newsitem.title: CHINA: China to redeem 120 bln yuan in state debt in 1997.
newsitem.headline: China to redeem 120 bln yuan in state debt in 1997.

text.p: China will face a state debt redemption peak this year with more than 120 billion yuan's worth maturing during 1997, the China Securities newspaper said on Thursday.
The bulk of the debt will mature in April, May and June and the Finance Minstry has allocated enough funds to banks and other financial institutions to cover the redemptions, the newspaper said.
State debt which matured over the past few years but which has not yet been redeemed can also be cashed this year, it said.
